title: Applied Materials, Intel expand partnership to speed AI chip development
key_facts: Applied announced on 6 Oct 2026 it is working with Intel to speed chipmaking innovations for transistors, interconnects and advanced packaging.
The work links Applied's EPIC Center in Silicon Valley with Intel's R&D campus in Hillsboro, Oregon.
It covers front-end and back-end interconnect scaling and Foveros-based 3D stacking packaging.
Intel is a founding partner of the EPIC Center.
CEOs Gary Dickerson (Applied) and Lip-Bu Tan (Intel) are quoted.
EPIC was announced 22 May 2023 with up to $4 billion in investment.
quote_evidence: Applied Materials announced on October 6, 2026 that it is working with Intel to accelerate development of chipmaking innovations for next-generation transistors, interconnects and advanced packaging technologies.
The collaboration links Applied's EPIC Center in Silicon Valley with Intel's research and development campus in Hillsboro, Oregon.
Applied said the packaging work supports higher interconnect density, improved power delivery and enhanced thermal performance.
why_it_matters_hint: Aims to shorten development time for AI chip technology.
